messages:
Jordan (AE): GoldBank needs BYO-HSM for inference. Requirements: CMKs in customer HSM, monthly automated rotation with dual-custody ceremony, pre-pilot pen-test, SIEM-forwarded key usage logs, and unwrap latency <20ms. Need feasibility + rough quote.

Rina (Solutions): Feasible. Options: Hosted + key-proxy (cross-VPC) or Dedicated with colocated proxy. For <20ms recommend peering or colocated proxy. Need peak QPS and 95p token length to size caches.

Ben (Security): We can provide FIPS attestations and HSM vendor certs. Audit logs can be pushed to S3 or direct collector via mTLS. Dual-custody: we support webhook-managed sign-off for rotation. Note: SLO for unwrap latency only for Dedicated + colocated proxy.

CC (FinOps): Ballpark pricing (procurement only): Hosted + BYO-proxy: ~$0.009 per unwrap + $400/mo baseline. Dedicated + colocated: ~$6.5k/mo baseline + ~$0.0015 per unwrap. Will confirm with finance.

Harper (GoldBank): Peak 1k rps, median 130 tokens, 95p 400 tokens. Pen-test must happen before pilot in 4 weeks. We prefer VPC peering.

Rina (Solutions): POC plan (3-week compressed): week0 network & certs; week1 deploy proxy + smoke tests; week2 integrate unwrap + perf tuning; pen-test scheduled in parallel during week2. Can compress with weekend ops.

ops-bot: Deploy started: key-proxy-staging -> goldbank-staging. Run id: rpt-20260615-09. ETA 45m.

Jordan (AE): Action items: CC to formalize per-1M numbers; Ben to share attestation pack and runbook; Rina to draft SOW appendix and test vectors for in-flight rotation; Harper to confirm peering request and pen-test vendor by EOD.

Harper (GoldBank): Will confirm vendor tonight. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
